title: Juicy Warm Ethiopian Citrus Bowl
description: A refreshing, citrusy, and crumbly Ethiopian dish featuring warm water, marinated with exotic spices. Serve immediately in an earthenware bowl.

ingredients.name: Finely chopped fresh ginger
ingredients.notes: about 1-inch piece of ginger, peeled and finely chopped

ingredients.name: Grated fresh turmeric
ingredients.notes: about 1-inch piece of turmeric, peeled and grated

instructions: In a large mixing bowl, whisk together the orange juice, olive oil, ginger, turmeric, marjoram, salt, and black pepper until well combined.
Add the cooked quinoa to the bowl and stir until the quinoa is evenly coated with the marinade.
Transfer the quinoa mixture to a preheated earthenware bowl and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional fresh herbs, if desired, for a pop of color and extra flavor.
